title: Outdoor Coil Sensor
fullDescription: Eleven flashes on York Affinity heat pump = coil sensor open or shorted.

title: High Pressure Trip
fullDescription: Twelve flashes flag high pressure cutout on York heat pump.

title: Reversing Valve Failure
fullDescription: Fourteen flashes = RV solenoid energized but mode did not change.

title: Hard Lockout
fullDescription: Sixteen flashes = compressor locked out, manual reset.

title: Discharge Temperature High
fullDescription: Seventeen flashes protect the compressor: discharge gas above 250F = low charge / TXV / restriction.

title: Defrost Algorithm Fault
shortDescription: Defrost ran max time without clearing 3x.
fullDescription: Eighteen flashes = demand defrost cannot finish.

title: Compressor Lockout - Repeat HPS
fullDescription: Nineteen flashes specifically lock out due to repeat HPS trips. Indicates persistent overpressure cause.

title: Compressor Lockout - Repeat LPS
fullDescription: Twenty flashes lock the compressor due to repeat LPS trips. Indicates real refrigerant or airflow problem.
